title: AP/AR OFF hides the 7 sensitive customer fields on Edit Customer
preconds: 1. A user has a role with Customers View and Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF.
steps:
1. Open Customers and open a customer.
  2. Open the Edit Customer window.
  3. Look for these 7 field labels: Credit terms, Credit limit, Default Labor rate, Default Shop Supplies, Min and Max, Taxes, PO is required.
  4. Look for the basic fields (name, address, phone, email, contacts, vehicles).
expected:
All 7 of those fields are hidden.

The basic fields are shown and can be edited.
